title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
description: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.
